nodes.name: health_monitor.rs
nodes.summary: Background health monitor that periodically tests watcher responsiveness, restarts unhealthy watchers, and falls back to slow polling when file-system watching is unavailable.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a `HealthMonitor` wrapping the shared state store, watcher, and event emitter.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Spawns the background health-check loop.

nodes.name: run_health_checks
nodes.summary: Runs on a 60-second interval: tests each watched repo's watcher responsiveness, restarts unhealthy watchers, and falls back to slow polling if restart fails.

nodes.name: enable_polling_fallback
nodes.summary: Switches a repository to slow-polling mode when file-system watching is unavailable or unhealthy.

nodes.name: polling_loop
nodes.summary: Background loop that polls git status every 60 seconds for repositories running in polling-fallback mode.

nodes.name: get_all_health
nodes.summary: Returns aggregated health status for all watched repositories.

nodes.name: get_watch_status
nodes.summary: Returns the overall watch subsystem status summary.

nodes.name: HealthMonitor
nodes.summary: Background health monitor that tests watcher responsiveness, restarts unhealthy watchers, and falls back to slow polling.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the repo-watching subsystem: declares the watch submodules and exposes a global `RepoWatchManager` singleton that wires together the state store, watcher, and event emitter, starting a background health monitor on initialization.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a `RepoWatchManager`, wiring the state store, watcher, and event emitter together and starting the background health monitor.

nodes.name: start_health_monitor
nodes.summary: Spawns the health-monitor background thread, checking watcher health every 60 seconds and restarting watchers after 3+ consecutive failures.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Initializes the global `REPO_WATCH_MANAGER` singleton with the given Tauri `AppHandle`, called once at app startup.

nodes.name: RepoWatchManager
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator tying together the repo state store, filesystem watcher, and event emitter behind a global singleton (`REPO_WATCH_MANAGER`).

nodes.name: state_store.rs
nodes.summary: Thread-safe in-memory state store for all watched repositories (cached git status, dirty flags, health/failure counters, active jobs) backing the watch subsystem.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an empty `RepoStateStore`.

nodes.name: add_repo
nodes.summary: Registers a repository in the state store with initial state.

nodes.name: remove_repo
nodes.summary: Removes a repository's state from the store.

nodes.name: get_all_repo_ids
nodes.summary: Returns the IDs of all currently tracked repositories.

nodes.name: get_all_states
nodes.summary: Returns a snapshot of all tracked repository states.

nodes.name: mark_dirty
nodes.summary: Marks a repository's cached status as dirty, forcing the next read to trigger a refresh.

nodes.name: is_dirty
nodes.summary: Checks whether a repository's cached status is currently marked dirty.

nodes.name: clear_dirty
nodes.summary: Clears the dirty flag for a repository after a fresh status has been computed.

nodes.name: update_status
nodes.summary: Stores a freshly computed `GitStatus` in the cache and clears the dirty flag.

nodes.name: get_cached_status
nodes.summary: Returns the cached `GitStatus` for a repository, if present.

nodes.name: is_cache_valid
nodes.summary: Checks whether the cached status for a repository is still within its TTL.

nodes.name: get_all_cached_statuses
nodes.summary: Returns cached statuses for all repositories that currently have one.

nodes.name: increment_failures
nodes.summary: Increments the consecutive-failure counter for a repository's health tracking.

nodes.name: mark_degraded
nodes.summary: Marks a repository as degraded with an optional reason, used when watching fails but polling continues.

nodes.name: mark_healthy
nodes.summary: Resets a repository's health state to healthy, clearing failure counters.

nodes.name: should_test_health
nodes.summary: Determines whether enough time has passed to warrant another health check for a repository.

nodes.name: is_unhealthy
nodes.summary: Checks whether a repository's consecutive failure count exceeds the unhealthy threshold.

nodes.name: update_health_check
nodes.summary: Records the timestamp of the most recent health check for a repository.

nodes.name: add_job
nodes.summary: Registers a background job as running for a repository.

nodes.name: remove_job
nodes.summary: Removes a completed or failed job from a repository's active job set.

nodes.name: get_job_count
nodes.summary: Returns the number of active jobs for a repository.

nodes.name: enable_watch
nodes.summary: Enables watching for a repository.

nodes.name: disable_watch
nodes.summary: Disables watching for a repository without removing its state.

nodes.name: is_watch_enabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether watching is currently enabled for a repository.

nodes.name: get_repo_count
nodes.summary: Returns the total number of tracked repositories.

nodes.name: get_health_stats
nodes.summary: Returns aggregate health statistics (healthy/degraded/unhealthy counts) across all tracked repositories.

nodes.name: RepoStateStore
nodes.summary: Thread-safe (`parking_lot::RwLock`-backed) in-memory store of state for every watched repository: cached status, dirty flag, health counters, and active jobs.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Type-definition hub for the watch subsystem: repo/watch state, git status structures, health/watch-mode enums, change-type/event structs, job queue types, and debounce configuration with resource-limit constants.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a fresh `RepoState` for a newly watched repository with default health/cache values.

nodes.name: is_cache_valid
nodes.summary: Checks whether this repo's cached status is still within its TTL.

nodes.name: should_test_health
nodes.summary: Determines whether this repo is due for another health check.

nodes.name: is_unhealthy
nodes.summary: Checks whether this repo's consecutive-failure count exceeds the unhealthy threshold.

nodes.name: default
nodes.summary: Default `GitStatus` value with empty file lists and all in-progress-operation flags cleared.

nodes.name: RepoInfo
nodes.summary: Identifies a watched repository (ID, path, display name) passed into the watcher.

nodes.name: RepoState
nodes.summary: Per-repository watch state: cached `GitStatus`, cache timestamp, health/failure counters, and watch-enabled flag.

nodes.name: GitStatus
nodes.summary: Full git status snapshot: branch, ahead/behind counts, staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted files, and in-progress merge/rebase/cherry-pick/revert/bisect flags.

nodes.name: GitStatusFile
nodes.summary: A single file entry within a `GitStatus` snapshot (path, status code, optional rename origin).

nodes.name: WatchStatus
nodes.summary: Overall watch subsystem status summary (mode, watched repo count) surfaced to the frontend.

nodes.name: WatcherHealth
nodes.summary: Per-repository health diagnostics (status, consecutive failures, last check time).

nodes.name: HealthStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of watcher health states (healthy, degraded, unhealthy).

nodes.name: WatchMode
nodes.summary: Enum of watch strategies: event-driven, smart polling, slow polling, or disabled.

nodes.name: RepoChangeType
nodes.summary: Enum classifying the kind of change detected for a repo: file, git metadata, branch, or remote.

nodes.name: RepoChangedEvent
nodes.summary: Event payload describing a detected repo change, its type, and affected file count.

nodes.name: JobPriority
nodes.summary: Priority levels for background jobs in the watch subsystem's job queue.

nodes.name: JobType
nodes.summary: Enum of background job kinds tracked by the watch subsystem.

nodes.name: Job
nodes.summary: Represents a single background job (type, priority, state) tracked per repository.

nodes.name: JobState
nodes.summary: Enum of background job lifecycle states.

nodes.name: DebounceConfig
nodes.summary: Configurable delay thresholds used by the debounce manager for different change types.

nodes.name: watcher.rs
nodes.summary: Core `RepoWatcher` implementation combining `.git/`-directory filesystem watching (instant detection of commits/branch switches/merges) with adaptive VSCode-style polling for working-directory changes, classifying and routing git path events by criticality.
nodes.languageNotes: Only watches the `.git/` directory (not the full working tree) to avoid EMFILE errors on large repos, falling back to polling-only mode with a degraded-health flag if even that watch fails.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a `RepoWatcher`, wiring up the debounce manager and starting both the background event-processing loop and the adaptive git-status polling loop.

nodes.name: start_git_status_polling
nodes.summary: Runs an adaptive polling loop on a dedicated thread (with its own current-thread Tokio runtime, since the global runtime isn't available at app-setup time): parks via a condvar when no repo is active or watch is disabled, applies health-aware exponential backoff, and otherwise polls at 5-30s intervals depending on window focus and Source Control visibility.

nodes.name: calculate_poll_interval_with_health
nodes.summary: Computes the polling interval: exponential backoff up to 60s when unhealthy, otherwise 5s/10s while focused (Source Control visible/not) or 30s when unfocused.

nodes.name: set_window_focused
nodes.summary: Updates the window-focus flag consulted by the adaptive polling loop.

nodes.name: set_source_control_attention
nodes.summary: Updates whether the Source Control UI is visible, bumping focused polling to the fast interval.

nodes.name: set_active_polling_repo
nodes.summary: Sets which repository is allowed to use periodic polling and wakes the parked poller if it was previously idle.

nodes.name: mark_git_change
nodes.summary: Records the timestamp of the most recent detected git change for a repository, used for adaptive polling frequency.

nodes.name: watch_repo
nodes.summary: Starts watching a repository's `.git/` directory only (not the full working tree, to avoid EMFILE on large repos), degrading gracefully to polling-only mode with a health flag if the watch call itself fails.

nodes.name: unwatch_repo
nodes.summary: Stops watching a repository: drops its filesystem watcher, removes its state, and cancels any pending debounce.

nodes.name: unwatch_all
nodes.summary: Stops watching every currently watched repository.

nodes.name: start_event_processor
nodes.summary: Runs a background thread that consumes filesystem events from the channel, classifies each one's change type, marks the repo dirty, and triggers a debounced status update.

nodes.name: classify_event
nodes.summary: Classifies a batch of `.git/` filesystem events as critical, debounced, or excluded based on path patterns (HEAD/refs vs index vs objects/logs), returning whether the event should be processed and whether it's critical.

nodes.name: determine_change_type
nodes.summary: Maps a `.git/` filesystem event's paths to a `RepoChangeType` (Branch, Remote, GitMeta, or Files) based on which git internal file changed.

nodes.name: test_watcher_health
nodes.summary: Health check that writes and deletes a temp file inside `.git/` to verify the filesystem watcher is still responsive.

nodes.name: restart_watcher
nodes.summary: Restarts a repository's watcher by unwatching and re-watching it, used after a failed health check.

nodes.name: RepoWatcher
nodes.summary: Watches one or more git repositories via a hybrid strategy: instant `.git/`-directory filesystem events for git operations plus adaptive polling (5-30s) for working-directory changes, with debouncing and health-aware backoff.
